findings.title: Preserve the legacy schema-validation procedure explicitly
findings.body: The original procedure requires users to “validate schemas.” This decision maps it only to role rendering and local source checks; the cited truth checker runs kubeconform only when it is installed, and the mapped install procedure does not require any schema-validation command. Thus the mapping weakens a distinct original claim rather than preserving it. Add a canonical target that requires the applicable schema validation (with supporting evidence), or make an evidence-backed obsolete disposition if that behavior is no longer supported.

findings.title: Add the required independent review for this new parity decision
findings.body: This commit adds only the author decision. The supplied author-only result explicitly says it is not semantic approval and that final inspection remains required. The parity contract requires a matching independent review, with distinct reviewer identity and passing semantic-parity, accuracy, target-specificity, and disposition verdicts for every claim. Without it, this source cannot become deletion-ready or pass the parity gate.

findings.title: Use a permitted disposition for navigation-only headings
findings.body: This claim marks a `navigation-only` heading as `current` and `mapped`. The parity contract's compatibility matrix permits `navigation-only` only as `non-reader-content` with an omitted navigation-only disposition; it does not permit the current/mapped pairing. The same invalid pairing is repeated for the other heading claims, so the decision will fail the contract gate. Reclassify these headings/dispositions according to the matrix or represent their substantive navigation as a supported claim type.
